$comment: Example tasks, published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after a deploy once the Actor is public (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md section 18). Task names are unique across the whole Apify account, so each carries wellfound. Limits: title 63, description 400, seoTitle 60, seoDescription 160 (154 kept), 10 per actor. inputSchemaFields must stay fields of the input schema. options follow defaultRunOptions in store.json.
